THE INSTRUMENT
Audio source

For tab capture, play music in its tab and click the extension icon. Demo uses simulated features. Share audio uses the browser’s chooser; audio availability depends on the browser and OS.

Playback
Color

A shuffled palette for each automatic scene. Turn off to keep the current palette.

Fabric & space

Density changes spacing by adding or removing persistent samples. Mark size changes the marks themselves.

Camera & quality
Spatial sources

256 polygon tours and 256 spherical video studies. Buildings, open game levels and measured terrain flex through the music.

Mapped geometry © OpenStreetMap contributors · ODbL. Models by Kenney · CC0. Levels by Freedoom contributors · BSD. US terrain from USGS via Mapzen / Tilezen · public domain. Video studies: UGC360 · CC BY-SA 4.0.

Video studies show nine source frames through a 180° view. Original footage is 360°; this is a glyph interpretation without reconstructed depth.

Sources, adaptations & data licences
Saved scenes

Scenes contain geometry, mappings, settings and initial state. Audio is processed locally and is never recorded or exported.
